name: security_test
description: Adversarial security testing of a running app or codebase: enumerate attack surface, probe for injection (SQL/XSS/command), auth bypass, IDOR, SSRF, insecure config, and secrets exposure; then produce a prioritized findings report with reproduction steps. Use when the user asks for a security test, pentest pass, or hardening review of the browser, bridge, or kernel. complements security_audit (static) with dynamic testing guidance.
